title: ASTM F3302-18 Standard for Additive Manufacturing - Finished Part Properties - Standard Specification for Titanium Alloys via Powder Bed Fusion
notes: Public ASTM store product page read on 2026-10-15. Listed as active, 2018 edition, page last updated 2018-02-21; no later revision is listed on the page or found in a web search the same day. Committee F42, subcommittee F42.05. Scope as stated on the public page: titanium alloy components made by full-melt powder bed fusion for applications needing properties similar to wrought products; parts may need post-processing such as machining or polishing to meet surface and dimensional requirements. Purchase required. Finished-part counterpart of F2924 for the delivered part; which of the two governs a given order is for the purchase contract and the supplier to state. No table is reproduced; the ASTM page states that use of AI on ASTM standards is prohibited, so only designation, title and scope are cited.
